finding.text: The onChange handler at L106-111 derives the key prefix from the name whenever keyPrefixAuto is true, but nothing in the diff ever sets keyPrefixAuto to false when the operator edits the prefix field. The test at L69-74 expects that after typing 'eng' into the prefix, a subsequent name change does NOT overwrite it — but the code as written WILL overwrite it, because keyPrefixAuto is still true. The CharterEssentialsFieldsProps includes onKeyPrefixEdited but the diff never shows it being called from the prefix field's onChange. This is a real bug: the operator's explicit prefix choice is silently discarded on the next name edit. The fix is to call onKeyPrefixEdited() from the prefix field's onChange (which flips keyPrefixAuto false), and the test at L73-74 is asserting exactly this behavior — but the implementation doesn't do it.
finding.suggestion: Call onKeyPrefixEdited() in the prefix field's onChange handler so that editing the prefix flips keyPrefixAuto false, and the name field stops deriving. The current code derives on every name change while keyPrefixAuto is true, but never turns it off on manual prefix edit.
